note: The four clips EPIC U owes the site (FR-93): the Agents card's mint-once dialog, a confirmation approved with a step-up, a confirmation refused by the shut operation gate, and the audit table. The one place web-ui.html's Agents section looks up an id, a file name and its alt text (node docs/site/tools/capture-agents.mjs --embeds html). Every clip is one variant: light, the standard window. The mock API scenarios named here are the ones #1351 adds to ui/shared/src/api/mock.ts.

gifs.name: agents-mint
gifs.alt: Settings, Agents: the mint dialog takes a name and a scope, shows the token once, and will not close until the operator confirms it is stored
gifs.caption: Minting a token. read is preselected, the token is shown once, and Done stays disabled until you say you stored it. Afterwards the list holds the prefix and never the token.

gifs.name: agents-approve
gifs.alt: A pending confirmation on the Agents card with the exact retnd command on it, approved after the password is entered
gifs.caption: A confirmation waiting for you, with the command it will run. Approve asks for your password, then replays the recorded request and nothing else.

gifs.name: agents-refused
gifs.alt: Approving a run_cycle confirmation while the operation gate is shut: the card shows the same refusal a person would get
gifs.caption: Approving run_cycle with the operation gate shut. The refusal is the one retnd run gives, DESTRUCTIVE_OPERATIONS_DISABLED, and the confirmation records that it was refused.

gifs.name: agents-audit
gifs.alt: The Agents card's audit table filtered to one token, one row per call, reads included
gifs.caption: The audit: one row per call, reads included, filtered by token and time.
